I'm sorry about the double charge. I can't promise a refund today, but I can get this moving.

First, check your bank app to see whether one of the charges is marked "pending". A pending authorisation isn't a real charge. Also, if LF-310022 shipped in several parcels, it can show one charge per parcel.

If both charges have posted, send me the **last four digits** of the card (never the full number or security code). Once the duplicate is confirmed, it will be refunded within **3 business days**.
